selection_rationale: M1083G10-01 proves that the two second-support gaps form a genuinely non-affine translation-invariant positive-product observable with exact tropical composition. M1083G10-07 uses simultaneous left/right feasibility to remove at most one equality-wall row and force both actual complement gaps on the remaining power-large core. M1083G10-09 combines that new complement rigidity with constant normalized source shape to give an exact range-one profile. Ten of twelve non-survivors are killed (83.3%); the two remaining proved scope/one-exception dependencies are not independent survivors.
